verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH client with cloud-synced team vaults, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question, but the evidence shows no API token or agent-credential feature, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404. Per-vault access control for team members and SSH key generation are adjacent features, not scoped API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
